question: Run a natural-language fusion search over already-ingested archived VSS video.
ground_truth: Loads vss-search-archive and runs top-level VSS fusion search on already-ingested archived video; not ad-hoc Q&A, source ingestion, source deletion, or live captioning.
expected_behavior: Loads vss-search-archive and runs fusion search on already-ingested archived video.
